name: Idexx Laboratories
outlook:
What Idexx Laboratories says to expect

  • Full year 2026: revenueIncreases 2026 revenue guidance to $4,741 million - $4,767 million, up $32 million at midpoint, reflecting strong CAG Diagnostics recurring revenue performance.
  • Full year 2026: revenue growthOutlook for 2026 reported revenue growth raised to 10.1% - 10.8%, and CAG Diagnostics recurring revenue reported growth raised to 11.0% - 11.7%, with projected 2026 organic revenue growth of 9.3% - 10.0% and CAG Diagnostics recurring revenue organic growth of 10.3% - 11.0%.
  • Full year 2026: earnings per shareRaises 2026 EPS outlook to $14.96 - $15.16, reflecting a $0.25 increase compared to prior guidance midpoint, led by a raised revenue outlook while supporting acquisition impacts.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 2, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
